Change Tracking
  ALTER DATABASE ... SET CHANGE_TRACKING = ON
  ALTER TABLE ... ENABLE CHANGE_TRACKING
  tracks: which rows changed (by key)

Change Data Capture
  reads the transaction log via an Agent job
  tracks: actual before/after column values
caption: Change Tracking is lightweight; CDC captures the real values.
